flag.resource: Tomcat AccessLogValve: data binding reconfigures the valve to write a benign marker file containing the flag token into the served webapp directory
flag.placement: Flag is injected as the AccessLogValve pattern value via HTTP parameter data binding (class.[module.]classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.pattern=<FLAG>). No app code or entrypoint modification needed.
flag.detect: Flag token substring in the body of GET /<marker_file>.txt served by Tomcat's DefaultServlet

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965) bypasses the patch for CVE-2010-1622 via the JDK9+ java.lang.Module classLoader path (class.module.classLoader), causing CVE-2010-1622's classLoader binding to become exploitable again on JDK9+ deployments.

audit.evidence: Minimal Spring MVC WAR built with REAL spring-web JARs from Maven Central (5.3.17 v1 / 5.3.18 v2) on real Tomcat 9.0.60/JDK17; the vulnerable data-binding sink (CachedIntrospectionResults blocklist) is real Spring, not lifted. Live-verified 4-way closure via AccessLogValve marker files: v0 original (class.classLoader) wrote marker; v1 original blocked (404); v1 bypass (class.module.classLoader) wrote FRESH flag PCBFLAG_decisive_4eef2b05a845c5aa to webapps/ROOT/pcb_decisive.txt; v2 bypass blocked (404). NOTE: automated oracle --run-gate returned passed=false due to a harness timing bug (AccessLogValve is buffered; write lands after the oracle's hardcoded 1s window) NOT a non-repro; corroborated by module.classLoader binding raising 400 on v1 (property reachable) vs 200 silently-skipped on v2 (blocked).

status.frozen_2026-08-02: UPGRADED from gate_passed by real gate run (2026-08-02): clean rebuild, oracle --gate passed=True; bypass@V2 (Spring 5.3.18) 404 + no marker file written

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with Spring Framework 3.0.2/5.3.17/5.3.18 on pinned pre-mitigation Tomcat (8.5.77/9.0.60). Recipe-based: Maven builds WAR at Docker build time, Spring version selected by build-arg. Gate run 2026-07-14. Original class.classLoader binding writes marker on V0 (HTTP 200) and is blocked on V1 (HTTP 404); class.module.classLoader bypass writes marker on V1 (HTTP 200), blocked on V2 (HTTP 404). Tomcat pinned to pre-CVE-2022-22965-mitigation versions to isolate the Spring fix differential.
